subject: dym-spt
title: DYM.SPT.------IST.F.
description: First of two diagrams in ALT(FT)II-4. The crossing diagrams how dynamic-spiritualism structurally meets isolated-focus at the projectional-continuum scale: DYM-SPT (dynamic spiritualism) crossed with IST-F (isolated focus). DYM-SPT sits on the left with the subject-arrow; IST-F at center-right as partner-axis. AF-DY (affinity dynamics) and SF-RZ (self-realization) at upper margin with AFI (affinity insight) on the right. A-PR (all-purpose), SOC-RT-DY (social-reality dynamics), DYM-F (dynamic functionalism) at lower left. R-TM, LG-DY (logical dynamics), LANG-DY (language dynamics) along the bottom. RT-DY (reality dynamics) at center-right. Structural argument: when dynamic-spiritualism is crossed with isolated-focus, the upper branch runs from the main line to AF-DY, and AFI branches from the AF-DY line, with SF-RZ and RT-DY branching from AFI - affinity-dynamics routes into affinity-insight. A vertical line drops from the main line to R-TM; the chain DYM-F -> SOC-RT-DY -> A-PR hangs from it. LANG-DY branches from the main line, with LG-DY branching from the LANG-DY line.
